name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth Client ID
help: A Scoped OAuth app registered on your own PagerDuty account. Only users of that account can connect, and each sees only what PagerDuty shows them.
setupSteps: Sign in to your PagerDuty account as a Manager, Global Admin or Account Owner, open Integrations > Developer Tools > App Registration, and select New App.
Give it a name and a description. Under Functionality, tick "OAuth 2.0" only, and continue.
Set Authorization to "Scoped OAuth". The form starts on "Classic User OAuth", which the gatekeeper can't use.
Under Permission Scope, grant these permissions: Incidents (read and write), Schedules (read and write), and read access to Services, Teams, Users, On-Calls, Priorities and Escalation Policies.
Select Register App, and copy the Client ID and Client Secret here.
